farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:74ab6812-54.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. TECHNOLOGY We're on a mission to build end-to-end products and technology that powers the an incredible e-commerce experience for luxury customers everywhere, understanding the motivations and needs of our customers and partners, to designing and testing hypotheses, to creating industry-leading experiences for luxury customers. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE As an Observability Engineer in the Tech Platform team, you will help build and maintain the core of our telemetry ecosystem. Your mission is to support a scalable and reliable platform for analysis, detection, and investigation, empowering users across FARFETCH Business Units through comprehensive coverage of telemetry data. In this role, you will be a valuable contributor dedicated to improving our observability infrastructure. You will work on building and optimizing data pipelines and storage solutions for Logs, Metrics, Traces, Profiling, and RUM, helping to reduce the cognitive load for developers while ensuring our telemetry systems maintain high levels of performance and resilience.
responsibilities: Assist in the design and implementation of robust observability infrastructure, focusing on the scalability, high availability, and performance of our core telemetry platforms.

Support the management of data pipelines and storage, ensuring the reliable ingestion, processing, and querying of Logs, Metrics, and Traces using technologies like OpenTelemetry (OTEL), Fluentbit, and the Victoria ecosystem.
Help build self-service capabilities that empower engineering teams and FARFETCH Business Units to be autonomous in their analysis, detection, and investigation efforts.
Monitor and maintain the reliability and performance of our internal observability stack, ensuring systems like Grafana and various exporters remain robust.
Support the integration of Observability Frameworks (Audit, Logging, Monitoring, etc.), ensuring they fit seamlessly into the broader platform architecture.
Actively participate in technical discussions, learn from senior engineers, and share your knowledge to foster a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety within the team.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:86bff9d2-b8d8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Australia. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation. rws-rws:lever:952e3e10-ad00-40c2-b4d3-ec.title: Social Media Content Evaluator (Portuguese)
rws-rws:lever:952e3e10-ad00-40c2-b4d3-ec.description: About the Role In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis. Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. Job Type: Freelance Location: Brazil (work from home) Work Schedule: Part-time — 4 hours per day required. (Flexible schedule: you can choose your hours as long as the daily time requirement is met). Work whenever you want. Start Date: Immediately Duration: TBC Rate: 6 USD per hour What You’ll Do Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present in the audio and on-screen text. Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., verifying that the media content uses authentic target language and aligns with the cultural context of that language). Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines. Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models. What we’re looking for: Must be currently living in Brazil. Native-level written and spoken fluency in Portuguese. Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop. Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines. (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:405280a1-a7d.title: Onsite Data Collection Project - (Seattle Based)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:405280a1-a7d.description: Overview Get Paid to Help Shape the Future of Technology We are building a community of participants for upcoming in-person data collection projects in Seattle. These projects help improve the next generation of smart devices and technology and we are looking for everyday people to take part. No experience is required. No special skills are needed. Simply attend your scheduled session, follow a few simple instructions, and get paid for your time. What You'll Do Participants take part in short, moderated sessions involving simple, everyday activities such as walking, sitting, or moving through a space while smart devices record the session. A friendly moderator guides you through every step. A trained moderator will guide you through the entire process. Project Details Job Type: Freelance/Independent Contract Time Commitment:Approximately 1 hour Location: Seattle Metro Area (On-site) Project Type: Short-term, paid, in-person research sessions Who Can Apply? We welcome people of all ages and backgrounds from across the Seattle region. To participate, you should: Adults and minors are eligible (participants under 18 require parent/guardian consent) Be comfortable following simple instructions in English (non-native English speakers are welcome). Feel free to register with friends or family, you are welcome to participate together.
